Vulnerabilities.Title: libX11: libX11: Heap-based buffer overflow via malicious X server
Vulnerabilities.Description: A malicious X server could exploit a buffer overflow in libX11 before 1.8.14 during handling of XkbGetMap overflowing the key_sym_map.
